purpose: Measure how many dimensions the character information actually occupies, both in the between-class structure and in what a fixed probe can use. This bounds whether dimensionality reduction or stronger regularisation can still help.

data.eeg: public train only, 50 ms log1p counts, per-session z-score fitted on the three training repeats

measurements.between_class_spectrum: per session, SVD of the 2748 class means (3 training repeats each), cumulative variance share at k = 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128
measurements.decoding_curve: per session-fold, PCA fitted on the training repeats, projection without whitening, nearest-centroid probe (train centroids, Euclidean), recall@32 on the held repeat, for k in 8,16,32,64,128,256 and full
measurements.no_whitening: experiment 76 showed whitening hurts, so the curve uses plain projection

interpretation_rule: if recall@32 at k=32 is already close to the full-dimension value, the usable signal is low-dimensional and further dimensionality work is pointless; if it keeps rising to full dimension, the signal is spread out and truncation only loses information
prohibited: fitting PCA on the held repeat
tuning k on the held repeat
